title: A Flow-Based Explanation for Return Predictability
one_line: Mutual-fund flows create predictable price pressure in the stocks funds hold: flow-induced pressure earns ~5% the next year and reverses (−5.7%) in years 2-3; this explains fund performance persistence and the 'smart money' effect and part of stock momentum.

findings.statement: Managers cut holdings ~1:1 on outflows (0.97) but only partly add on inflows (0.62).
Expected flow-induced price pressure decile spread +5.28% next year, −5.67% quarters 6-12.
Controlling for it cuts the momentum coefficient 25-50%.

why.pattern: Flow-driven demand shocks with later reversal.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
